Houdini Traffic System

A procedural traffic system in Houdini. A lane graph built in VEX defines every route — inbound, outbound, connectors, and the roundabout ring — and a traffic solver drives the cars along it, so the same city can run as a traffic-light intersection or a roundabout.

Below: renders from the toon-shaded city, the lane graph for both junction types, and the VEX solver code — car following, speed control, and roundabout give-way.
